messages:
mira_fin: FYI SparkLabs flagged an unexpected charge surge on their Nov invoice. They ran a scheduled internal load test but claim we billed it as production. Invoice INV-SPARK-20271101 shows an extra ~1.12M tokens (~$1,120).

leo_partnerops: we did a stress run at 2027-11-14T22:10Z - 22:40Z. We expected those to be tagged as test traffic, but looks like spikes show up on our bill.

zara_platform: looking now. I see emit events with customer_id=spark_labs and tag.env=prod for that window. There is a config toggle flip in the feature-store around 2027-11-14T22:05Z that set prod_metering=true for the partner org.

kai_eng: that toggle was flipped by infra rollout to enable end-to-end tracing for a partner pilot. It was supposed to be scoped to dev accounts but a regex mismatch included spark_labs. Example audit: 
```
feature_store.set('prod_metering', true, scope='partners/.*') // rolled 2027-11-14T22:04:58Z user=infra-deploy
```

metering-bot: Alert: unusual-partner-metering spike detected for spark_labs between 2027-11-14T22:10Z and 2027-11-14T22:40Z. delta_tokens=1120340.

mira_fin: we need a fast resolution: options are 1) mark those emits as non-billable via backfill; 2) issue a credit memo. Since invoices are already issued, finance prefers to apply a credit after verification.

leo_partnerops: backfill would be ideal so billing records reflect reality. We can tag emits with backfill id BF-4050 and nonbill=true since traffic originated from partner test range.

zara_platform: BF-4050 prepared. Plan: scan request logs for customer_id=spark_labs in window 2027-11-14T22:00-23:00, validate header x-test-run and user-agent patterns, then emit metering markers nonbill=true. Estimated run 50m.

kai_eng: root cause fix: tighten regex and add gate so prod_metering toggle requires explicit org allowlist. PR infra/feature-toggle#155 open.

mira_fin: approve provisional credit up to $1,300 while backfill runs. If backfill succeeds we will void the provisional credit. Approve?

sam_support: customer support note ready: "Thanks — we discovered a mis-scoped feature flag during an infra pilot that caused some of your test traffic to be recorded as production. We're backfilling to mark those requests as non-billable and will issue a credit if reconciliation can't be applied before the invoice window closes. ETA ~1 hour." ok to send now?

mira_fin: send investigating message with BF-4050 and FIN-1160 refs.

metering-bot: Backfill BF-4050: started at 2027-11-15T00:05Z.

zara_platform: progress 60% — found 1,120,340 tokens matching test UA and x-test-run header. No checksum mismatches. Emitting nonbill markers.

metering-bot: BF-4050: progress 100% — markers_emitted=1120340.

zara_platform: backfill completed at 2027-11-15T00:53Z. reconciliation id SPARK-RECON-20271115. Metering topic shows those emits annotated nonbill=true.

mira_fin: finance: please record reconciliation reference SPARK-RECON-20271115 against INV-SPARK-20271101 and void provisional credit. I'll open FIN-1160 and billing-adjustments card.

leo_partnerops: customer replied they appreciate the quick handling and asked what we changed to prevent recurrence.

kai_eng: action items: 1) merge infra/feature-toggle#155 to gate toggles by exact org id; 2) add preflight validation for prod_metering flips; 3) add a dashboard card for partner-metering spikes and a pager if >0.2% of daily tokens.

mira_fin: closing FIN-1160 after invoice notes update & credit void. thanks team.
